title: Giants put Roy Robertson-Harris on IR, sign two players

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants put Roy Robertson-Harris on IR, sign two players
sources.description: Giants defensive lineman Roy Robertson-Harris tore his Achilles during the team's offseason program, but they put him on the physically unable to perform list rather than injured reserve to open training camp.
